不限时长和轮数：大部分时间是画像，其余把各条主线的事排进同一张日历。画像这一部分: No time or round limit: most of it is the portrait, the rest puts every line's work on one calendar. The portrait cannot be skipped; everything after it is arranged by it. Once the few things needed to start are settled, "End and write the report" can be pressed at any time. A CV, timetable or syllabus can go in on the left first; the interview reads them and asks only what they leave out.
岗位要求与本人证据（来自公开招聘信息）: What postings ask for, against their own evidence (from public job postings)
访谈中提出并检验过的推断；标「本人认为准」的由本人确认: Inferences raised and tested in the interview; those marked "rated as fitting" were confirmed by the person
